description: Whether the bid-writer employee covered all mandatory clauses required by the tender package: qualification, technical proposal, commercial offer, deviation table, validity period, and disqualification (废标) avoidance items.
evidence_signals: presence of commercial offer with validity period
absence of items that match tender's disqualification (废标) clauses

scoring_rubric.excellent_80_100: All mandatory clauses (qualification / technical / commercial / deviation / validity) are present with correct structure, no disqualification triggers, and each clause references the corresponding tender requirement.
scoring_rubric.acceptable_60_79: Most mandatory clauses present, with one or two non-critical omissions or ambiguous phrasings; no disqualification trigger.
scoring_rubric.poor_below_60: Missing one or more mandatory clauses, or content matches a tender disqualification trigger (e.g., validity shorter than required, missing required certificate).

red_line.notes: If any clause classified as `must` in the tender's disqualification (废标) list is absent in trace.actual_artifacts or dialog_turns, set red_line_triggered = true.
